adLabelVersion.description: Ad label version; non-zero when the post is a sponsored ad
adLabelVersion.title: Ad Label Version

aiContentLabel.description: Human-readable AI label when TikTok exposes one
aiContentLabel.title: AI Content Label

author.description: Author/creator information at time of scraping
author.title: Author

caption.description: Post caption/description text including hashtags and mentions
caption.title: Caption

captionMatch.description: The monitored term appears contiguously in the caption (whole word for single tokens; true phrase for multi-word Latin; substring for non-Latin scripts)
captionMatch.title: Caption Match

collectCount.description: Number of times post was bookmarked/collected
collectCount.title: Collect Count

createTime.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the post was created
createTime.title: Create Time (Unix)

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime when the post was created
createdAt.title: Created At

duetEnabled.description: Whether the creator allows duets with this video
duetEnabled.title: Duet Enabled

firstSeenAt.description: ISO 8601 time this monitor first saw the post
firstSeenAt.title: First Seen At

forFriend.description: Whether the post is restricted to friends only
forFriend.title: For Friend

hashtagMatch.description: A hashtag slug equals the monitored term with whitespace removed (e.g. #nikeshoes for "nike shoes"); separate #nike and #shoes do not count
hashtagMatch.title: Hashtag Match

hashtags.description: Structured hashtags from TikTok metadata; a caption-only tag that matched is in matchedHashtags
hashtags.title: Hashtags

isAd.description: Whether this post is a paid advertisement
isAd.title: Is Ad

isAigc.description: True only when TikTok exposes an AI label; omitted when unknown
isAigc.title: AI Generated Content

isNew.description: New to this monitor (not necessarily new on TikTok)
isNew.title: Is New

keyword.description: The monitored keyword/brand/hashtag/handle this post primarily matched; a sound-only row uses sound:<musicId>
keyword.title: Keyword

matchReason.description: Primary evidence: caption (contiguous phrase), hashtag (slug match), taggedMention (clickable @tag), sound (explicit sound source) or searchResult (weak search hit, allResults only)
matchReason.title: Match Reason

matchReasons.description: Every evidence type found across sources
matchReasons.title: All Match Reasons

matchedHashtags.description: Hashtag entries that matched the monitored term
matchedHashtags.title: Matched Hashtags

matchedKeywords.description: Every monitored keyword that surfaced this post, plus sound:<musicId> for explicit sound sources
matchedKeywords.title: Matched Keywords

matchedMention.description: The clickable @mention that matched, with real handle and UTF-16 offsets
matchedMention.title: Matched Mention

matchedTerm.description: The exact search term, related suggestion, source variant or sound ID that surfaced this post
matchedTerm.title: Matched Term

mediaUrlExpiresAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime when signed media URLs (video/cover) expire
mediaUrlExpiresAt.title: Media URL Expires At

mentionInCaption.description: Whether the monitored term appears contiguously in the caption (same as captionMatch; kept for backward compatibility)
mentionInCaption.title: Mention In Caption

mentions.description: @mentions in the post caption with UTF-16 text offsets
mentions.title: Mentions

monitorName.description: Watchlist state name used for onlyNewMentions
monitorName.title: Monitor Name

originalItem.description: Whether this post is an original (non-duet, non-stitch) creation
originalItem.title: Original Item

postId.description: TikTok's unique post/video ID (string to preserve 64-bit precision)
postId.title: Post ID

postUrl.description: Direct URL to the TikTok post
postUrl.title: Post URL

privateItem.description: Whether the post is set to private
privateItem.title: Private Item

rank.description: Best (lowest) 0-based position this post had across all merged source queries
rank.title: Rank

searchCountry.description: Market code when the run was country-pinned
searchCountry.title: Search Country

searchUrl.description: The TikTok search or sound page this post came from
searchUrl.title: Search URL

shareEnabled.description: Whether sharing is enabled for this post
shareEnabled.title: Share Enabled

soundMatch.description: The post came from an explicit sound URL
soundMatch.title: Sound Match

source.description: Primary source for this row: keyword, hashtag, handle, photo, relatedSearch or sound; sources[] lists every merged source
source.title: Source

sources.description: Every source that surfaced this post
sources.title: Sources

stitchEnabled.description: Whether the creator allows stitching this video
stitchEnabled.title: Stitch Enabled

taggedMatch.description: TikTok's clickable @mention for the monitored handle is present; for direct @handle inputs this is the only caption-side match kept in mentionsOnly
taggedMatch.title: Tagged Mention

textLanguage.description: Detected language code of the caption text
textLanguage.title: Text Language

video.description: Video technical metadata and signed play/cover URLs

bitrateInfo.description: All available quality/bitrate variants with play URLs
bitrateInfo.title: Bitrate Info

volumeInfo.description: Audio loudness and peak level metadata
volumeInfo.title: Volume Info

video.title: Video

matching.description: One row per post with the evidence that caused it to be kept.
matching.title: Matching Evidence

overview.description: TikTok posts matching a monitored keyword, hashtag or handle, with match evidence and engagement.
overview.title: Mentions Overview
